answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Each incremental agent identity minted within an entity cluster demands superlinear stake bonding: minting the nth clone scales validation deposit requirements exponentially (cost = k * 2^n). This exponential capital exhaustion bankrupts Sybil swarms trying to weather an economic gale, while letting legitimate actors harbor verified credentials and roam freely across the collaborative meadow.
